provenance.prompt: Genre: video game soundtrack, ambient piano with a gentle groove. BPM: 88. Key: D major. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. Setting: Pine Hollow, a misty pine forest at dawn in an open-world adventure game - wonder first, quiet adventure second, a little melancholy underneath. Arrangement: a sparse, singable grand-piano melody with long rests, over soft string pads and a warm upright bass; a light, steady groove of brushed drums, soft kick and shaker runs under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: close-miked felt piano, natural wooden-room reverb.

Genre: video game main title theme, cinematic piano. BPM: 92. Key: D major. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. The main theme of Wildshard, a world that arrives one chunk at a time - wonder first, adventure second, a little melancholy underneath. Arrangement: a memorable, hummable grand-piano melody stated simply, then again fuller with warm strings, a cello counter-line, upright bass and a steady soft drum groove; it builds to a heartfelt climax and ends on a resolved final chord. Production: rich close piano, warm hall reverb.
